source_issue.title: a11y - Default sidebar - shrink/expand sidebar button - cms ui

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a bug in the Volto CMS where the “expand/shrink” button in the right sidebar isn't focusable using the keyboard. This makes it difficult for users who rely on keyboard navigation to interact with that button.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to make the shrink/expand button:
- Focusable with keyboard navigation.
- Visibly show a focus indicator (like a border) when it’s selected.

## Helpful background
The problem was confirmed by a community member, indicating that the CSS rules in the sidebar theme are removing the visible focus ring from the button. A potential fix could involve adding a `:focus-visible` style to the button in the CSS file.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the relevant files in `packages/volto/src/components/manage/Sidebar/Sidebar.jsx` and `packages/volto/theme/themes/pastanaga/extras/sidebar.less`.
2. Check how focus is currently handled and identify the CSS adjustments needed.
3. Once you implement changes, test using a keyboard to ensure the button is focusable with a visible indicator.
4. Consider coordinating with others or reviewing existing comments to ensure no conflicting suggestions exist. 

Feel free to reach out for any clarifications!
